## Progress log

- 2026-09-25 — reconnaissance (continued thread): canonical compare seam
  confirmed — `hh_eval::compare::CompareInput` (crates/hh-eval/src/compare.rs),
  `hh_analysis::project::eval_run` (ResultsRow→EvalRun, refuses missing
  fields), `hh_results::project_row` (durable prefix→ResultsRow),
  `hh_analysis::kernel::compare_input` assembles the input (benefit_kind
  ArtifactBenefit). `hh-embed` is the natural test home: it depends on
  experiment+results+analysis+eval+lab, keeping hh-lab/hh-eval ownership
  boundaries clean (test-side driver, no new production edge).
  `lab.eval.compare` is records-in/records-out (eval_ops.rs) — the test
  can also exercise the embed op path. `Driver::open_react` +
  `KernelSink` (crates/hh-embed/src/runtime.rs) drive real subject runs
  into a Store under the launched subject writer lease.
  `scripts/check-removability.sh` already carries the hosting-edge-free
  check (lines 61–84); the G2-3 leg needs an actual `--exclude
  hh-hosting` workspace test run recorded.
- 2026-09-25 — **`benchmarkSet` landed + real-suite legs (G2-1).** The
  WIP `hh_bench::benchset` loader (`src/benchset.rs`, committed at
  24b69fe) verified: strict schema/consistency validation, unknown-member
  and wrong-id refusal, deterministic reload. Corpus =
  `crates/hh-bench/fixtures/benchset/stage3_v1` —
  `benchset.stage3.v1`, four strata (A `suite.tb2`, C `suite.swebench`
  retired-for-headline, D `suite.taubench`, E `suite.agentdojo`), recorded
  `model_io` + recorded original-runner verdicts + split-hash/assignment
  records + deterministic-grader fixture adapters. `LEDGER.md`
  `benchmarkSet` flipped `PENDING_CREATE` → `benchset.stage3.v1`.
  `crates/hh-bench/tests/s3_12b.rs` (new): `t_lcd_03_round_trip_over_stratum_c`
  (T-LCD-03 round-trip, n=5 held-out stratum-C tasks through the canonical
  `hh-control` Driver + replay path), `adapter_parity_legs_over_the_corpus`
  (A/C/D/E through the corpus's own adapters — materialize/expose/collect/
  grade, not mocks), `parity_compare_refuses_unbudgeted_arm` (an
  undeclared arm refuses). Dev-deps `hh-control`/`hh-gateway` added to
  `hh-bench` (test-only; CC10/CC6 — the bench crate itself keeps no
  control-plane edge).
- 2026-09-25 — **exemplar→`ComparisonReport` (G2-2).**
  `crates/hh-embed/tests/s3_12b.rs` (new): both exemplar families
  register/expand/drain through the real `ExperimentEngine` over a real
  `Store` + `LabDocs` (compaction 30 plans, control-strategy 50 incl. the
  `iso_cost` companion); accepted subject runs honestly record
  `control.budget.consumed` on every declared matched dim, then project
  `project_row` → `eval_run` → `analyze` → `hh_eval::compare` —
  producing `ComparisonReport{budget_match.status = matched}` for
  `arm:evict_oldest`×`arm:clear_tool_results` and
  `arm:minimal-a`×`arm:steerable-a`. The cross-mode compare
  (`steerable-a` × `steerable-a-iso`) refuses `IncommensurableMatch` —
  ADR-0213's interim rule exercised, not assumed.
- 2026-09-25 — **retirement chain engine-driven end to end (Reading-1
  caveat).** `retirement_chain_is_engine_driven_end_to_end`: a
  `retirement` spec settles 30 plans through the engine; settled rows
  project+compare through `hh_eval::compare`; `removal_verdict` reads the
  produced `CompareOutcome` (⇒ `Pass` inside the margin);
  `settle_removal_test` ⇒ `RetirementEligible`; human-sealed `retire` ⇒
  `expired → retired` with `evidence_ref` = the produced report. No
  verdict is fed in.
- 2026-09-25 — **discovered residual (DF-S3.12b-1).** With every matched
  dim honestly measured, `ExperimentEngine::close`'s E-4 recheck writes
  `measurement.experiment.closed` members (`utilization` per arm × dim,
  `budget_match.detail` per comparand dim) that exceed
  `AUDIT_FIELD_MAX_BYTES = 512` under the class's `OPEN_AUDIT` partition —
  `AuditFieldsTooLarge` refuses the row (compaction: 525 B; control:
  966 B). The prior engine test only recorded `model_calls`, so the cap
  never bound; the `closed` row's E-4 member shape vs the audit bound is
  a real defect — asserted in the tests (`assert_close_audit_cap`),
  carried as DF-S3.12b-1, not under-measured to fit (CC3). The G2-2
  comparison is unaffected: `budget_match` is computed from the runs'
  consumption, pre-close.
- 2026-09-25 — **OQ-363 status (D7).** ADR-0213's interim rule
  (duplicate-run control for the `iso_cost` companion) **stands for
  Reading 2** — the iso arm ran as a distinct subject set, and the
  cross-mode `compare` refused `IncommensurableMatch` in executable form.
  No ADR amendment needed; run-sharing stays the open question.
- 2026-09-25 — **§9.4 vs §10.7 discrepancy (G2-5), documented.** §9.4's
  Stage-3 gating list is broader than §10.7's cited row: it includes
  AC-R-2.10.4-{3,6,7,11} and AC-R-2.5.3-7 (the latter explicitly deferred
  at S3.9 → DF-S1.17-3), while §10.7 stages KA-3/-6/-7/-11 at "3–4" —
  i.e. §10.7 treats some §9.4 members as later/mixed-stage. S3.12b claims
  only the §10.7 automated-gate cells it executed; which list governs
  Stage-3 acceptance (in particular AC-R-2.5.3-7's deferred arm) remains
  the operator's Reading-2 question — recorded, not resolved here.
